exposure: Lung recruitment maneuver (LRM) during mechanical ventilation (MV-AC/VG)
outcome: Endothelial injury (flow cytometry for endothelial microparticles CD-31+/CD-42-)
Neonatal microcirculation (transcutaneous-artery CO2 gap, TcPCO2-PaCO2; transcutaneous O2 index, TcPO2/PaO2)
Time to achieve the lowest FiO2
cohort: The participants were 110 preterm infants (<32 weeks) with severe respiratory distress syndrome requiring MV-AC/VG, divided into LRM and control groups.
finding: LRM did not negatively affect preterm infants and, among survivors, it reduced the time to achieve the lowest FiO2, shortened respiratory support duration, and improved the TcO2 index.
